"(a) Issue a writ of certiorari quashing the preliminary notification dtd .05.11.2015 in No. CI 135 SPQ 2015 Bengaluru vide Annexure-A and final notification dtd.26.08.2016 in No.CI 135 SPQ 2015 Bengaluru vide Annexure-D.
